obligors.name: Tower Health
obligors.rationale: Distressed exchange (S&P D). Original bondholders took NPV impairment via deferred amortization to 2039. Post-exchange paper rallied but pre-restructuring holders lost ~20-30% of par.

obligors.name: UC Health (Cincinnati)
obligors.rationale: DSCR -2.66 in FY23 vs 1.10x covenant. S&P warning. Recovery underway.

obligors.name: Frederick Health Hospital
obligors.rationale: Fitch BBB Rating Watch Negative + ransomware. 3 yrs op losses.

obligors.name: Mount Sinai NYC
obligors.rationale: Moody's downgrade Baa1→Baa3 Aug 2024. Two-notch action.

obligors.name: Allegheny Health Network
obligors.rationale: Below typical DCOH floor (53/65). Highmark consolidation masks at parent level.

obligors.name: Nuvance Health
obligors.rationale: Northwell merger absorbed it 2024-25 — spread compressed on takeout.

obligors.name: UofL Health
obligors.rationale: Fitch downgrade BBB+→BBB Aug 2024. Critically low 30 DCOH.

obligors.name: Boston Medical Center
obligors.rationale: Moody's downgrade Baa2→Baa3 in 2026. Steward acquisition weakening.

obligors.name: ProMedica Health System
obligors.rationale: Turnaround story: 8.1% operating margin in 2025 after 2022 covenant breach. Ratings (Ba2/BB) lag operating reality — re-rate to BBB-area would tighten ~75 bps.

obligors.name: Naples Comprehensive Health (NCH)
obligors.rationale: Fitch BBB+ stable. 108 DCOH. Expects breakeven FY26 — modest tightening on stable execution.

obligors.name: Adventist Health (West Coast)
obligors.rationale: Split-rated A3/A-/BBB+. 138 DCOH. Already priced fairly; limited alpha.

obligors.name: Lompoc Valley Medical Center
obligors.rationale: Small standalone, illiquid. Probably no name-specific alpha — just BBB sector return.
